text: Marcus Oyelaran and SRE Ananya Reddy stand up Prometheus to scrape metrics from catalog-api and checkout-api.
A Grafana dashboard covers request rate, latency, and error rate for both services, in real time.
The production alert defines an error as any non-2xx HTTP status code from checkout-api, over a rolling five-minute window.
They test it by forcing a real 500 error in staging -- Alertmanager fires and pages on-call correctly.
Next: deploying both services to EKS through a staged, approved rollout.
